import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    st = np.sqrt(t)
    w = params[5]
    c = np.cos(w*st); s = np.sin(w*st)
    return (params[0] + params[1]*x + params[2]/v + params[3]/x + params[4]/x**2
            + (params[6] + params[7]*st)*c + (params[8] + params[9]*st)*s)
